2. Power

• {{custom_values.power_requirement}} within reach of the setup area

• If the venue has no suitable outlet, ask us about the generator add-on before the day

3. Access

• Vehicle access to unload within a reasonable distance of the setup area

• Doorways and paths wide enough for the equipment on a cart

• We arrive about {{custom_values.setup_time_required}} before the start time {{contact.event_start_time}} and pack out after the booked hours
